title: Calculation of Success Rate
body: ### What did you do? Success rate = Success count / Request count. However, when there are no requests, the expression should return 100. The provided expression is as follows: 100 *(sum(node_log_metric_monitor_value{key="test202508082_req_suc_count",agg="count",service_group="gateway_log",retcode="success",code="template_create"}) by (code,retcode)/(sum(node_log_metric_monitor_value{key="test202508082_req_count",agg="count",service_group="gateway_log",code="template_create"}) by (service_group,code) or vector(1))) No matter how I debug, it's very difficult to meet the requirement of returning 100 when there are no requests, instead of NaN.If there is no request to return 100, it may lead to the generation of alerts due to misconfiguration. We hope to improve this through expressions. ### What did you expect to see? ### What did you see instead?
